name: Shiphtan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan: so wait a minute. So earlier, in the same book of Numbers, when Moses was still the leader, Joshua was the head or the prince of the tribe of Ephraim. But after Moses has to die, Joshua got raised up to the leader of all Israel. Guess what? Another brother got promoted to be the head of the tribe. Kemuel got promoted. You understand?
